decks.notes: The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to control the game using a combination of disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, along with powerful planeswalkers like Narset, Parter of Veils. The deck aims to outvalue opponents by generating card advantage through cards like Omen of the Sea and Hopeless Nightmare, while also having a strong late-game threat in the form of Kaito, Bane of Nightmares. With a focus on disrupting the opponent's game plan and generating incremental advantage, this deck aims to grind out victories in a long game.

The main concept of this Gruul Aggro deck is to quickly deploy aggressive creatures onto the battlefield and utilize burn spells to remove any threats in the way. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures like Questing Druid and Pawpatch Recruit, supported by burn spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage. The inclusion of cards like Monstrous Rage and Emberheart Challenger further enhances the aggressive nature of the deck, putting pressure on the opponent to react quickly or risk being overrun. Overall, this deck focuses on fast, efficient aggression to secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells to enable the Arclight Phoenix's ability to return from the graveyard, creating a strong aggressive presence on the battlefield. It utilizes cheap instants and sorceries to trigger the Phoenix's ability, while also drawing cards and controlling the opponent's board with cards like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse. The deck also includes some versatile cards like Brazen Borrower and Temporal Trespass to provide additional options and potentially close out the game quickly. With a strong mana base and a mix of removal and card draw, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and flying threats.

This Boros Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a combination of low-cost creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to maintain constant pressure on the opponent by playing aggressive creatures like Ghitu Lavarunner and Monastery Swiftspear, while also using burn spells like Lightning Helix and Burst Lightning to deal direct damage. The deck's mana base and spells are carefully designed to maximize damage output and efficiency, allowing the player to quickly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the Greasefang Parhelion combo, using cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Fear of Missing Out to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and abilities. It includes a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to generate value through its creatures and artifacts, while also applying pressure to the opponent with its aggressive playstyle.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on applying constant pressure on the opponent by playing efficient creatures and disruption spells. The key strategy is to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize while utilizing powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to quickly bring down the opponent's life total. The deck also includes burn spells like Torch the Tower and powerful enchantments like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to maintain pressure and overwhelm the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to close out games quickly through aggressive plays and efficient resource management.

The main idea of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Unstoppable Slasher, while disrupting their game plan with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, and finish off the opponent with powerful finishers like Archfiend of the Dross and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck also utilizes lands like Mutavault and Blazemire Verge to increase its versatility and efficiency in combat.

This deck focuses on utilizing Spirit creatures to apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and removal. The key strategy revolves around playing efficient threats like Skyclave Apparition and Supreme Phantom, while protecting them with counterspells like Spell Queller and Spell Pierce. The deck also aims to maintain a consistent tempo by utilizing cards like The Wandering Emperor and Rattlechains to outmaneuver the opponent. Additionally, the mana base is designed to support both colors efficiently and allow for smooth gameplay.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a Rakdos color combination. It aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with powerful creatures and disruptive spells. Key cards include Bloodtithe Harvester for life gain and damage, Fable of the Mirror-Breaker for card advantage and Fear of Missing Out for extra pressure. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provides a strong threat while Unholy Annex / Ritual Chamber offer flexibility. Removal spells like Go for the Throat and Fatal Push keep the board clear while Thoughtseize and Duress disrupt the opponent's plans. Overall, this deck seeks to win fast and decisively.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively with creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and using disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the opponent's hand. It also includes powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Blade of the Oni to further pressure the opponent. In addition, it utilizes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Blightstep Pathway to generate value and maintain board presence. The deck aims to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and close out the game quickly with a combination of strong creatures and removal spells.

The deck focuses on casting cheap spells to trigger the abilities of Arclight Phoenix and other cards that benefit from casting multiple spells in a turn. It also includes card draw and some disruption to control the pace of the game. The goal is to quickly fill the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix and overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and creatures. The deck aims to be fast-paced and aggressive, using efficient spells to maintain pressure on the opponent and close out the game quickly.

The main idea of this Gruul Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. It focuses on quickly playing creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Heartfire Hero to deal damage early on, supported by burn spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage. The deck also includes some versatile creatures like Manifold Mouse and Pawpatch Recruit for additional pressure. With a mix of creatures, burn spells, and lands that provide flexibility in mana production, this deck aims to maintain a strong offensive presence throughout the game.

The deck also includes removal spells such as Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with threats. The mana base is carefully optimized to ensure smooth casting of spells, allowing the deck to stay ahead in tempo and dominate the battlefield.

The deck also features removal spells such as Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to handle opposing threats. The key strategy is to maintain a fast pace and overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize, utilizing powerful cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to maintain momentum.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. It aims to control the game through a combination of removal spells, powerful enchantments, and versatile creatures. The inclusion of Bring to Light allows for flexibility in finding the right answer for any situation. The deck is designed to outvalue and outlast opponents through a mix of card advantage, versatile threats, and powerful removal options.
